content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Wichita

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and hours leading projects or teams. PMI sets specific thresholds; Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your standing before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend sessions designed for working professionals in Wichita—flexible scheduling lets you balance study with your current role. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI with proof of your completed contact hours and qualifying experience. Pay the associated exam fee when you submit. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation and application timing to keep your pathway on track.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and reinforce key domains before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and workshops that count toward PDU requirements. Plan your renewal early to avoid credential lapse.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
